review_output: {"summary":"I found no blocking problems in the supplied code. Locks are taken in the order you described, and the caps hold under concurrency. Key retries return early without inserting rows or using quota. Limit responses match your stated contract. Two minor issues remain: the session lifetime isn't limited to the current live or replay phase, and transaction timeouts return a 500 instead of a retryable error.","findings":[{"area":"Session lifetime / mode binding","severity":"MINOR","file":"src/lib/live-metric-version.ts","issue":"The session's end time is only limited by the version, the admission credential, and the context. It isn't limited to the end of the current live or replay phase, so a 'live' session can outlive the live phase.","evidence":"The resolver returns expiresAt: versions[0].expiresAt. It checks that runtime.state is playing or replay, but never uses endedAt, replayAvailableUntil, or the scheduled end to cap expiresAt.","impact":"The receipt's expiresAtMs can say the session is valid after the live ends or the replay window closes. Intervals could then be counted against the wrong-mode version, unless ingestion checks the phase again on every interval.","recommended_fix":"Return expiresAt = min(version.expiresAt, end of the current runtime phase), using the same phase rules resolveLiveRuntime uses.","required_test":"Issue a session while the live is playing, with the live ending before the version expires. Assert that expiresAtMs is no later than the live end. Do the same for replay against replayAvailableUntil.","confidence":0.55},{"area":"Error mapping under lock contention","severity":"MINOR","file":"src/lib/live-metric-session.ts","issue":"Prisma's transaction timeout and maxWait errors (P2028, also P2024 when the connection pool is exhausted) aren't mapped to retryable_conflict, so they fall through to a generic 500.","evidence":"The catch block only maps 40P01, 40001 and P2034 to retryable_conflict. FOR NO KEY UPDATE on the submission and admission rows makes lock waits likely, with a 10000 ms timeout and 5000 ms maxWait.","impact":"When many requests compete for the same submission, viewers get a non-retryable 500 'Unable to create metric session' instead of a 503 they can retry.","recommended_fix":"Map P2028 and P2024 to retryable_conflict. Optionally add a short Retry-After header to the 503 response.","required_test":"Hold the submission row lock from a second backend PID for longer than the timeout. Assert the response is 503 and that no session or registration row was inserted.","confidence":0.6}]}
